reason: Follow-up to #622: a provider tool turn's answer cites the excerpts knowledge.search delivered to the model (ChatService._turn_citations in _completion, read from the durable step ledger via knowledge_search.searched_citations; deduplicated against attached knowledge; weak matches only when the answer refers to them; conversation.search never cited). Both searches now keep only what fits the 8 KiB model-delivery bound (tool_results.fit_model_result), since an oversized result reached the model as a size notice. Selected: the knowledge.search tests (citations, restart, delivery bound, fit helper), conversation.search tests (delivery bound), reranker tests (shared search path), the chat tool loop and routing-prose/synthesis tests (every completion goes through _completion), test_chat.py (plain-turn completions keep their citations), reference material and knowledge index tests. Counts from pytest --collect-only.
exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright tests: no UI change. The existing citation chips render tool-turn citations; checked on the production bundle served by a scratch Core in desktop Chromium 1440, mobile Chromium 390 and mobile WebKit 390 (evidence in the PR body). The local-only reranker calibration test stays skipped in CI. Harness gateway results are not turned into citations (harness turns own their answer assembly). No full suite.
